constitutional_basis: Art. XXVIII (prediction is not observation), Art. LII (falsification contract), Art. XXVII (threshold and band provenance)
directive_basis: R407-C: before experiment, PREDICTION_BEFORE.json; R407-A: the frozen contract's model expectations
falsifiable_statement: if the measured residual floor flow at the PRIMARY_ONLY arm falls outside the registered band of these predictions at 2+ heads, the Poiseuille engineering model is falsified for this bench regime and must be updated through the adjudication machinery

held_out_condition.role: any model update from the experiment is fitted on the 10 and 20 mmHg training conditions and evaluated on the 40 mmHg held-out condition (R407-D)

predicted_decision_if_model_holds: KEEP (all heads far above Q_min 0.4; G ratio within +/- 30% if Poiseuille holds)

prediction_uncertainty.model_form_component: entrance/exit losses, developing flow, partial simulant occlusion — all unmeasured; the +/- 30% band is the registered container for them
prediction_uncertainty.registered_band: +/- 30% (the Poiseuille-validity band, ENGINEERING class, frozen in the pre-registration)
